title: The wheel of fortune
paradigm: Tversky & Kahneman (1974) anchoring with an obviously random anchor
intro: A random number generator has produced the number shown below. First say whether the true value is higher or lower than that number, then give your best estimate.
question: What percentage of the member states of the United Nations are African countries?
debrief: The number was random and carried no information, yet in the original study the group anchored on 10 estimated 25% while the group anchored on 65 estimated 45%. Today 54 of 193 UN members (28%) are African. Compare your estimate with the reference median for your anchor.
